title: Session 010 — Stage 0 Consistency Rulings
lede: Three semantic corrections need a ruling. Earlier GM decisions about the door framing and the approved monster enrichments are preserved.
footer: Applied without asking: four mechanical corrections in session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md — three Mirna spellings and one four-bugbear count clarification.

items.t: Correct which object visibly flared during Zenvon and Veyra's stone comparison?
items.y: Edit summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:8 so only Veyra's blue crystal flares while the two objects resonate. This follows the transcript and campaign state.
items.n: Leave the summary saying that both objects flared in summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:8, preserving the stronger visual embellishment despite the source mismatch.
items.ev: The transcript says, ‘Her blue crystal flared even brighter in response, the two objects resonating’ at session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well_transcript.txt:90-92. docs/campaign_state.md:83 records the same sequence.

items.t: Change Sister Maela's definite identification of a necromancer to a suspicion?
items.y: Edit the summary, scene bullet, and Sister Maela entry at summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:20,92,177 to say Maela suspected a powerful necromancer. Veyra's later tattoo reading remains the actual confirmation.
items.n: Leave Maela's inference framed as a definite identification in those three passages, collapsing her suspicion and Veyra's later confirmation into one beat.
items.ev: Maela says there is ‘probably a necromancer’ at session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well_transcript.txt:970-976. Veyra confirms the necromantic symbols later at session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well_transcript.txt:1027-1031.

items.t: Remove the unobserved wreckage and scattered-goods details from the abandoned caravan?
items.y: Edit summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:18 to say the party found signs that an abandoned caravan had been attacked, without specifying visible wreckage or scattered goods.
items.n: Keep the current wreckage and scattered-goods imagery in that summary passage as defensible scene texture, even though the transcript does not establish those details.
items.ev: The transcript establishes ‘some caravan that had been attacked by bandits and had been abandoned’ and leaves the attackers unknown at session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well_transcript.txt:795-801; it does not mention wreckage or scattered goods.
